hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Sort the input numbers in non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: The minimum difference between any two distinct elements must occur between adjacent elements in sorted order.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Iterate through adjacent sorted pairs to find the smallest absolute difference.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minAbsoluteDifference(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    nums.sort()
    ans = float('inf')
    for i in range(1, len(nums)):
        ans = min(ans, nums[i] - nums[i - 1])
    return ans
```

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n) and the adjacent difference scan takes O(n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorts in place requiring constant extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that minimal absolute gap is always between sorted neighbors.
